source.description:
Ko Chun-hsiung in Classic Film Portrait

A striking black-and-white photograph features Taiwanese actor Ko Chun-hsiung wearing a dark suit and light-colored tie, his gaze focused beyond the frame. His neatly styled hair and composed expression convey the refined elegance typical of mid-20th-century cinema.

Ko Chun-hsiung rose to fame through a range of roles, from romantic leads in Taiwanese-language films like “Goodbye, Ah Lang” to heroic figures in Mandarin-language war dramas such as “Plum Blossom” (1976). source.title: 亞洲影帝《柯俊雄電影人生》 紀錄片首映會戲迷齊聚 - 民視新聞網
source.description:
亞洲影帝柯俊雄紀念肖像

這張黑白肖像捕捉了柯俊雄的溫暖微笑與自信神情，他身著西裝、打著領帶，略帶顆粒感的影像質感營造出濃厚的懷舊氛圍。作為首位獲得亞洲影展最佳男主角的台灣演員，柯俊雄在1967年憑《寂寞的17歲》奠定影帝地位，並在往後數十年中以多變的角色形象和精湛演技贏得無數獎項。

2015年柯俊雄因肺癌病逝，享年70歲。為了紀念他的傳奇一生，妻子蔡青樺與金鐘主持人陳凱倫合作，歷時三年並獲文化部支持，製作了紀錄片《柯俊雄電影人生》。首映會於中午舉行，吸引了演藝圈好友與眾多戲迷到場，共同回顧他豐富的作品與傲人成就。

source.title: 柯俊雄图册_360百科
source.description:
Ko Chun-hsiung Portrait

This formal studio portrait features veteran Taiwanese actor Ko Chun-hsiung seated against a dark, neutral background. He wears a vertically striped shirt and rests his hand thoughtfully on his chin, meeting the camera with a calm, introspective gaze. The lighting accentuates his facial contours and the fine details of his attire, conveying a sense of dignity and poise.

The image is the first in an eleven-photo gallery on the 360 Baike website, which offers navigation controls and links to view additional details about each photograph in the Ko Chun-hsiung album.

Ko Chun-hsiung at a Formal Gathering

Ko Chun-hsiung, the renowned Taiwanese actor and controversial figure, is seated in a dark pinstripe suit paired with a vibrant red tie and tinted sunglasses. The background reveals a bustling event atmosphere, with attendees and media equipment softly out of focus.
